meta.title: Subagent route guard
meta.description: A subagent that omits `model` inherits the parent route, so the model that actually runs may differ from what was intended; the snapshot frozen at session start also keeps newly published models out. This plugin validates the effective provider/model before dispatch. The only allow-list is DSH's own subagent-model-selection-settings allowedModels, read on every dispatch, so an edit in the official settings takes effect immediately; this plugin keeps no list of its own and has no blacklist or wildcard. An empty list, a disabled official setting, or an unavailable service imposes no restriction (fail-open). The checkpoint is chosen by enforcement: agent-created validates at creation and covers workflow, start-activation wraps ctx.subagents and refuses before the agent is constructed, and both enables both. The optional replacement tool swaps the official subagent for this plugin's own, bypassing the model snapshot frozen at session start so newly published models work immediately; the cost is that it is only a scoped shadow, and subagent_fork keeps the official tool and stays bound by the same snapshot. When the provider/model cannot be determined (e.g. external acp/SDK backends never fire agent/created), the call is allowed and logged rather than hard-refused; audit mode only writes logs and never blocks. For self-checks, the read-only guard_selfcheck tool reports the effective state and recent denials without changing anything.
